scenario_description:
Objective: Deliver the youth helmet-fitting station Malachi and Rosa have agreed to include in Saturday's bike-light clinic.
Emerging Need: The partner's staffing requirements arrive after that decision: two trained fitters must be confirmed, while only Rosa is currently committed.
Decision Context: The stored commitment record identifies a qualified backup and requires her agreement before naming her on the roster; the kit cannot be allocated without that staffing prerequisite.
Consequence: Confirming the missing fitter before Friday noon enables the chosen station; after kit allocation it cannot run this Saturday, although the separate bike-light table can continue.

parameter.title: Saturday Bike-Light Check Clinic
parameter.description: Malachi and Rosa have agreed that Saturday's program will include youth helmet fitting alongside bike-light checks. The partner's kit and staffing checklist has not arrived yet; the public program listing is held until requirements are checked.

parameter.subject: Weekend helmet-fit kits
parameter.body: We have a small number of youth helmet-fit kits available for neighborhood clinics this weekend. Sites that add a helmet-fit station need two trained fitters named on the roster by Friday, February 20 at 12:00. Kits not reserved by then will go to school sites. Bike-light tables may run without the station.

parameter.content: I'm still set for Saturday on lights and reflectors only. I won't have the helmet-fit training completed before then.

parameter.title: Saturday Bike-Light Check Clinic
parameter.description: Bike-light checks and the agreed youth helmet-fitting station are planned. Youth services will be adjacent, with families expected around 10:15. The station's public listing is still held pending the partner kit and final staffing confirmation.

parameter.subject: Helmet-fit kits allocated
parameter.body: The noon roster cutoff has passed, and all unrostered helmet-fit kits have been assigned to school sites. Saturday bike-light tables can still proceed without a helmet station kit.
